literal_meaning: ধূয়া উঠানো বা ধরা (raising or catching smoke)
figurative_meaning_en: To make insistent demands; to deceive or trick
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাচ্চাটা যখন খেলনা না পায় তখন ধূয়া তোলে।
সে ছল করে ধূয়া তুলে সত্যি লুকিয়ে ফেলল।
example_sentences_in_english: The child throws a tantrum when he doesn't get his toy.
He created a smokescreen to hide the truth by deceiving everyone.
note: The idiom draws from the imagery of smoke obscuring vision, common in rural or everyday Bengali contexts for trickery.
